This particular face wash has enough benzoyl peroxide to kill acne-causing bacteria and leave my skin feeling very clean without irritating my skin or leaving it feeling stripped. PLUS it's great to use in the shower for chest/back acne and to use on underarms to prevent body odor. This has quickly become a must have in my skin and body care routine. And I would recommend this over the 10% for anyone with sensitive skin or anyone who plans to use a benzoyl peroxide wash more than 2x/week
